title: Leave Request Check
description: Stops a time-off request costing more (or meaning something else) than the person thinks by reading it back day by day as calendar days, working days and the leave it really uses, and flagging weekends and holidays at the ends, a sandwich rule from your policy that charges the weekend in between, a half day with no half chosen or one that leaves a working gap, a balance going negative and teammates already away, with one-tap fixes and the date they're back at work.
